entries.name: ◇SKILLS
entries.purpose: AGENT DOSSIER > SKILLS tab — the capabilities granted by the objects at this agent’s workstation, shown as a perk grid with a "GRANTED — N LIVE" header.
entries.promise: The "N LIVE" count equals the run-path grant: a perk is LIVE iff its cap is null (the always-on compute freebie) OR its cap object is placed at the workstation (World.heroCaps). N == the count of .perk.on tiles == what composeOffice actually grants — never a decorative number.
entries.notes: Live 78351f3e: header "GRANTED — 1 LIVE"; exactly 1 perk .on (COMPUTE, cap===null freebie); World.heroCaps(hero)=[] (no placed cap objects) so only the freebie is LIVE. header N == perkOn == 1. This mirrors sidecar composeOffice ("compute freebie + placed caps", office.js) — the dossier-SKILLS-honesty law upheld; capgate.test.js locks the run-path grant. Ev crew2-proof.json + skills-honesty-final.json.

entries.name: minimum gap between turn-in beats per agent
entries.purpose: Minimum gap (minutes) between reflection turn-in beats per agent — throttles how often memories are proposed.

entries.notes: live-proven wave-6: probe-memcfg.json — reflectCooldownMs 180000->300000 persisted across GET.

entries.name: input

entries.notes: live-proven wave-6: probe-memcfg.json — GET returns reflectEnabled, POST+GET round-trips reflectCooldownMs 180000->300000 persisted, scopeNote truthful.

entries.name: SAVE

entries.notes: live-proven wave-6: probe-memcfg.json POST returns postOk with no error; persisted on re-GET.
